kebab_example: aliyun dyvmsapi cloud-create-exten --enterprise-id 7000002 --exten 9000 --password Aa248236 --call-power 0 --is-ob 1 --is-direct 1 --ib-record 1 --ob-record 1 --area-code 010 --jitter-buffer 0 --type 2 --allow 1 --iad-name example-string --property '{}' --denoise 0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CloudCreateExten

parameters.help_en: The extension number. Must be 3 to 11 digits
parameters.name: exten

parameters.help_en: Specifies the calling permission. Valid values: `0` (Unlimited), `1` (National long-distance), `2` (Local), and `3` (Internal calls only). The default value is `0`
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫权限；0：无限制，1：国内长途，2：国内本市，3：内部呼叫，默认无限制
parameters.name: call_power

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to allow outbound calls. Valid values: `0` (disabled) and `1` (enabled). The default value is `1`
parameters.help_zh: 是否允许外呼；0：不允许，1：允许，默认允许
parameters.name: is_ob

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to allow off-hook dialing. Valid values: `0` (disabled) and `1` (enabled). The default value is `1`
parameters.help_zh: 是否允许摘机外呼，0：不允许，1：允许，默认允许
parameters.name: is_direct

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to record inbound calls. Valid values: `0` (disabled) and `1` (enabled). The default value is `1`
parameters.help_zh: 呼入是否录音；0：不录音，1：录音，默认录音
parameters.name: ib_record

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to record outbound calls. Valid values: `0` (disabled) and `1` (enabled). The default value is `1`
parameters.help_zh: 外呼是否录音；0：不录音，1：录音，默认录音
parameters.name: ob_record

parameters.help_en: Specifies the area code for the extension
parameters.name: area_code

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the jitter buffer. Valid values: `0` (disabled) and `1` (enabled). The default value is `0`
parameters.help_zh: 网络防抖；0：关闭，1：开启，默认关闭
parameters.name: jitter_buffer

parameters.help_en: Specifies the registration type for the extension. Valid values: `1` (IAD gateway), `2` (softphone), and `3` (remote phone)
parameters.help_zh: 类型；1. 注册到IAD分机 2.注册到webrtc 3.注册到远程话机
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the codec configuration by its ID.
Valid values:
`1`: `g729`
`2`: `g729, alaw, ulaw`
`3`: `alaw, ulaw, g729`
`4`: `alaw, ulaw`
`5`: `myopus, alaw, ulaw`
`6`: `myopus, g729, alaw, ulaw`
`7`: `myopus, g729`
The supported configuration depends on the endpoint and network:
- Remote phone + public network: `1`, `2`, or `3`
- Remote phone + leased line: `1` or `2`
- Softphone + public network: `4`
- Softphone + leased line: `5`
parameters.help_zh: 允许的语音编码,支持格式: 1. g729 2. g729,alaw,ulaw 3. alaw,ulaw,g729 4. alaw,ulaw 5. myopus,alaw,ulaw5. myopus,alaw,ulaw6. myopus,g729,alaw,ulaw 7. myopus,g729 公网+远程话机支持配置1/2/3;专线+远程话机支持配置1/2;公网+软电话支持配置4;专线+软电话支持配置5;
parameters.name: allow

parameters.help_en: Specifies the name of the IAD gateway. This parameter applies only when `Type` is set to `1`
parameters.help_zh: iad网关；该参数只有在类型为，注册到IAD分机，才有效
parameters.name: iad_name

parameters.help_en: Specifies custom properties for the extension in a JSON-formatted string
parameters.name: property

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable noise reduction. Valid values: `0` (disabled) and `1` (enabled). This parameter applies only when `Type` is set to `2`
parameters.help_zh: 降噪开关；0:关闭 1:开启 (该参数只有在类型为注册到webrtc才有效)
parameters.name: denoise
